## Purpose

Explain the mathematical arc of the unit and how it supports later study.

::: {.learning-objectives}
### Unit outcomes

- List measurable outcomes synchronized with the course outcome file.
- Include conceptual, manual, computational, and interpretive expectations.
:::

::: {.prerequisites}
### Readiness check

Link prerequisites and provide two or three short questions with collapsed,
step-by-step solutions. Direct learners with gaps to the relevant review.
:::

## Unit map

Introduce each lesson in catalog order. Explain what it contributes rather than
repeating its title. End with the unit challenge and estimated study plan.

## Central ideas and notation

Preview the definitions, notation, and connections that unify the unit. Link to
the notation guide rather than duplicating global conventions.

## How to study this unit

Recommend a deliberate cycle: predict, reason manually, compute where useful,
interpret, verify, and retrieve the idea later without notes.

## Readiness checkpoint

Add a brief topic-specific prediction or classification task with a collapsed
answer. Do not introduce a full lesson before its prerequisites.

## Unit resources and next step

Link the first lesson, relevant reference pages, generated notebook collection,
and eventual unit challenge.
